'''R3-D5''' was an [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3 series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that saw operation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was assigned to [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin's]] [[Saesee Tiin's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]] and saw combat over [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]] during a [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|dangerous mission]].<ref name="CR">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
R3-D5 first appeared in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|the Clone Wars]] episode "[[Citadel Rescue]]," an episode from the third season of the series. [[The LEGO Group]] later included the droid as a minifigure in the set [[W:c:lego=9498 Saesee Tiin's Jedi Starfighter|9498 Saesee Tiin's Jedi Starfighter]].
